description: This file defines the CompatTabListener interface, which mirrors the android.app.ActionBar.TabListener interface, providing callback methods for tab selection events in an Android app's tab navigation component.

classes.name: CompatTabListener
classes.description: An interface that defines callback methods for tab selection events, allowing compatibility with different Android API levels.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Callback invoked when a tab is selected, passing the tab and fragment transaction.

methods.name: onTabUnselected
methods.description: Callback invoked when a tab is unselected.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: Callback invoked when a tab that is already selected is reselected.
